data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were GBP 18.633m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows net favourable development on prior years (2019-2021) totalling approximately GBP 1.827m (a c.9.8% release of opening gross reserves), driven by favourable claims development and reserve estimate improvements on older Medical Malpractice years.
raw_causal_phrases: The ultimate cost of outstanding claims is estimated using a range of techniques including actuarial and statistical projections, benchmarking, case by case review and judgement.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
This includes assumptions in respect of average claim costs, claim handling costs, claim inflation factors and claim numbers for each underwriting year.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure derived from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative gross claims estimates) on page 35 because no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line is provided. Financial statement amounts are presented in GBP '000; conversions to millions performed for this output. No explicit narrative sentence quantifying gross prior year movement was found.
